note: Every Home Assistant REST API endpoint Fabric Warden calls, with the published documentation it was checked against. All calls are GET.
sources: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/homeassistant/components/device_tracker/const.py (state attribute names ip, mac, host_name, source_type)
base: http://<host>:8123 (or :80 behind the Supervisor); the REST API is under /api/
auth: Authorization: Bearer <long-lived access token> (created on the user's profile, under Security). A non-admin user is enough: every endpoint used is readable without the Admin marker, and results follow the user's permissions.

endpoints.used_for: Connection test: {"message": "API running."} (the trailing slash matters)
Every entity's state; Fabric Warden keeps only the selected categories below

entity_selection.ups: sensor.* whose entity_id or friendly_name contains the word "ups" (inferred from the name; Home Assistant has no UPS device class)
entity_selection.tracker: device_tracker.* whose attributes.source_type is router, or that carries ip/mac attributes (ScannerEntity); GPS trackers are skipped so no location is stored

not_used: Every POST endpoint (states, events, services/actions, template, config check, intents)
